# IE Academy - Interactive Digital Educational Platform

IE Academy is an advanced electronic educational ecosystem linking private tutors/instructors with center and remote students. It supports smart attendance tracking via QR codes, recorded lectures, quizzes, and automated subscription tracking.

## Core Features

- **Tutor Profiles:** Detailed bios, schedules, courses, and ratings.
- **Student Center:** Attendance records, quiz scores, tasks, and homework logs.
- **Lesson Library:** Categorized recorded video lessons available offline.
- **QR Code Attendance:** Instant contactless check-in at physical learning centers.
- **Admin Control Panel:** Approval of instructor subscriptions and platform moderation.

## URLs & Pages

- Landing Page: https://ie-academy.pages.dev/ (Public)
- Terms of Use: https://ie-academy.pages.dev/terms.html
- Privacy Policy: https://ie-academy.pages.dev/privacy.html

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, CSS variables, Glassmorphism
- Backend & Database: Supabase Cloud Database (PostgreSQL)
- PWA: Offline caching & service worker integration
